<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Peterson reaction for the given target molecule. We'll search the template catalog using criteria: the forward reaction breaks a trimethylsilyl group and an alcohol (C‑O) bond and forms an alkene (C=C). Then we can apply the found template to the target SMILES to get all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "alcohol"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
